answer_1.quote: We employ GPT-4 to generate succinct argument structures... By taking the cause-effect pairs extracted from WIKIWHY as input, the GPT-4 is prompted with crafted examples to generate diverse causal claims linguistically without accessing external information.

answer_2.quote: We propose two new evaluation metrics focusing on argument structure generation. • Structure Similarity... BERTScore based on DeBERTa‑large is used as the scoring function. • Exact Match Similarity... structures are regarded as sequences of edges, but a match is considered successful only when the predicted edge exactly matches the gold edge.

answer_4.quote: We randomly select 50 instances and ask three graduate students with NLP background to assess the generated argument structure according to the following criteria with binary score. • Validity: Is the generated argument structure logically coherent? • Win/Tie/Lose: Comparing the generated argument structure against the provided reference.
answer_4.guideline: Assess the generated argument structure according to the criteria: Validity and Win/Tie/Lose.
